text:
Maria L.: heads up — noticed repeated chart flicker + big main-thread parse spikes on dashboard after we rolled telemetry-proxy canary last night. LCP regressed ~200–400ms for heavy boards. :frowning:
Jake: reproable on canary? steps?
Maria L.: yes, canary eu1. Steps: open op-metrics dashboard, switch time range, click a few filters. Flamegraphs attached in the perf traces link — main thread shows a big hump in 'telemetry-client.parsePayload' during chart init. :eyes:
deploy-bot: deploy finished: telemetry-proxy-canary @1768430000 by @ci/cd (image: telemetry-proxy:v2.3.1-canary)
Nieves: I pulled the build artifacts — telemetry-client bundle grew ~820KB minified in the last build. Diff shows we inlined the schema mapper + lz4-js decoder for on-the-fly decompression. That explains the parse hump.
Ashleigh: ugh, we shipped the LZ4 decoder into the main bundle to avoid an extra roundtrip. That was the PR for schema-forwarding. Maybe lazy-load the decoder instead?
Jake: agree. quick options: 1) lazy-import decoder only when compressed telemetry arrives, 2) route telemetry payloads to a worker thread (off main) via postMessage, 3) revert the schema-forwarding change from canary. Any preference?
Maria L.: worker thread + lazy-load seems ideal long-term. Short-term rollback for canary to restore SLA. I'll open a rollback ticket.
Nieves: re routing — the proxy change also altered routing policy: it now forwards raw payloads to frontend for feature flags/metadata extraction. Previously we streamed a preprocessed summary. That + larger bundle = double whammy.
Ashleigh: can we flip the proxy to send the summary for the canary bucket only? config flag is 'forward_raw_payload: true' — if we flip to false for canary it should reduce client work.
Jake: yep. snippet to toggle in routing policy service:
```
route_rules:
  - match: canary=eu1
    telemetry:
      forward_raw_payload: false
      quota: 100rps
```
Do we have permission to patch canary routing now?
Maria L.: I'll coordinate with infra — can do a targeted config flip for eu1 canary for next 10m window.
Nieves: also adding telemetry-sample to the console so we don't parse full events for every chart — sampling at the proxy will cut the parse load drastically.
Ashleigh: for the longer term: we should split telemetry-client into two entrypoints: telemetry-core (sync small helpers) + telemetry-decode (lz4, schema mapper) and dynamically import decode in a worker. That keeps baseline bundle tiny.
Jake: logging/observability asks: add a metric for 'client_decode_time' and a flag in traces to mark when decode happened on main thread vs worker. That will help rollback verification.
Maria L.: created rollback PR -> #3121 and a follow-up RFC issue for split-entrypoint -> #3122. Rolling back canary now. Will watch charts for 30min.
deploy-bot: rollback started: telemetry-proxy-canary -> telemetry-proxy:stable (triggered by Maria L.)
Nieves: quick perf note: the flamegraph shows 320ms spent inside a small function `mapEventFields` which got pulled into hot path when schema-on-client was added. We can memoize that mapping for the short term too.
Ashleigh: thanks — I'll do a tiny patch for memoization + add worker plan to RFC.
Jake: thanks team. After rollback, please share new trace IDs so eng-platform can verify the LCP numbers.
Maria L.: will post traces in 10m. :thumbsup:
